# Icon

`content/icon` &middot; content-level &middot; category: content

## Purpose

A small icon image with a fixed size and alignment.

## Required fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `icon` | image { src, alt } |  |

## Optional fields

None.

## Variants

Same data and structure, different styling. Pick one with `{ variant: 'name' }`.

- **default**: 48px icon.
- **small**: 32px icon. Sets `size: 32px`.
- **large**: 72px icon. Sets `size: 72px`.
- **round**: Circular crop, use a square source. Sets `radius: 50%`.

## Settings

Every setting has a default. Values may be token references (`@colors.accent`, `@theme.card.radius`). Pass overrides with `{ settings: { ... } }`.

| Setting | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hideOnMobile` | boolean | `false` |
| `hideOnDesktop` | boolean | `false` |
| `size` | length | `"48px"` |
| `align` | alignment | `"center"` |
| `radius` | length | `"0"` |
| `padding` | spacing | `"0 0 @spacing.sm 0"` |

## Responsive behavior

- `hideOnMobile`: hides it below 480px. Outlook desktop and Gmail on non-Google accounts ignore media queries and still show it.
- `hideOnDesktop`: shows it only on phones. Clients that ignore media queries keep it hidden.

## Compatibility

| Outlook desktop | Gmail apps | Dark mode |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Fixed width honored. Border radius ignored. | Fine. Keep meaning in adjacent text in case images are blocked. | Icons are not recolored. |



## Example usage

This is a content-level component: it goes inside a column, so put it in the `content` of a `layout/section` (or another layout).

In an email (`.mjml`):

```
[[ c('content/icon', {
  "icon": {
    "src": "https://placehold.co/96x96/png?text=%E2%9C%93",
    "alt": "Free shipping",
    "width": "48px"
  }
}) ]]
```

As data (a node, for recipes and the remix API):

```json
{
  "component": "content/icon",
  "data": {
    "icon": {
      "src": "https://placehold.co/96x96/png?text=%E2%9C%93",
      "alt": "Free shipping",
      "width": "48px"
    }
  }
}
```
